items.docs:
Creates a SuggestionBox page from given data.

**Required attributes:**
- `site_id` - ID of the site to create the page on
- `name` - Display name for the page
- `status` - Publication status ('published', 'draft', 'unlisted')

**Optional attributes:**
- `slug` - URL-friendly identifier -- `https://yoursite.com/slug` (auto-generated from name if not provided)
- `content` - Description/instructions for the page
- `tag_list` - Comma-separated list of tags to be used for categorizing Suggestions

- `site_id` - ID of the site to place the SuggestionBox page on
- `name` - Display name for the SuggestionBox page
